note: Renaper's own tariff on argentina.gob.ar (read 2026-11-03), at the rates paid from 6 March 2026: a first DNI for anyone born in Argentina, from birth to 18 (Decree 415/2006, art. 13), and a late first identification are free; the updates at 5 or 8 and at 14 and a new copy (later updates, a correction, a change of address, any other copy) cost ARS 10,000; express issue, within 96 working hours, costs ARS 26,000 in all, issue within 24 working hours, collected at the office of origin, 41,000, and issue on the spot 57,000, each only at offices that offer it. The 96 and 24 working hours are held as four working days and one. A first copy by naturalization or by option of nationality costs ARS 10,000 (not modelled); whether a first DNI can be had the faster ways isn't stated, so only the regular way is offered for it. The DNI's term and the regular time aren't on the tariff, so they're null. Diario de Cuyo's report (read 2026-10-28) had the first DNI free only up to six months, so the game charged ARS 10,000 for it, and the express and 24-hour times unknown: corrected from the tariff.
